description: Source code for an Android foreground service (RecorderService) and its binder (RecorderServiceBinder) managing audio recording functionality, including lifecycle management, recording control, and coroutine-based timing.

classes.name: RecorderService
classes.description: An Android LifecycleService managing recording lifecycle, states, and binding.

classes.name: RecorderServiceBinder
classes.description: Binder class providing control over MediaRecorder, recording state, timing, and unbinding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the binder with lifecycle scope and application context.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder instance when service is bound.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by stopping recorder and nullifying binder.

methods.name: killRecorder
methods.description: Stops and releases MediaRecorder, optionally stops the service.

methods.name: initializeRecorder
methods.description: Sets up MediaRecorder with output file and URI, and prepares it.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Starts recording and launches coroutine to track recording time.

methods.name: stopRecordingAndUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds service connection and stops recording.
